exposure: admission to an intensive care or high dependency unit
outcome: Incidence of severe primary postpartum hemorrhage
Admission to an intensive care or high dependency unit
cohort: Women who gave birth in Victoria, Australia between 2003 and 2013 (n = 764,244)
finding: The incidence of primary postpartum hemorrhage, severe primary postpartum hemorrhage, and associated maternal morbidities have increased significantly over time in Victoria.
mod_finding: Women who had an unassisted vaginal birth had the lowest incidence of primary postpartum hemorrhage, while the highest incidence was in women who had an unplanned cesarean section birth; women who had a forceps birth had the highest incidence of severe primary postpartum hemorrhage.
